answer: Each identity must arrive with its own deposit address, funded at least three hops from any existing member and held unspent through the epoch. At close the ledger walks the funding graph: accounts whose money converges on one ancestor within three hops collapse into a single vote, and the branch's escrowed yield burns. Three hops on Base cost about $12 in gas plus $25 locked per seat, so a thousand puppets burn roughly $37,000 before earning a cent. A harbor never asks each hull its name; it watches which wharf the lines run back to, and a reef of identical hulls is one rock.
